criterion_text: On an approved Linux native integration runner, two simultaneously live Sessions using one managed Workspace see the same writable /workspace and the same verified host physical Overlay mount; ending Session A does not revoke Session B, while releasing the last consumer safely unmounts without deleting the persistent upper/work.

verifiers.summary: Two concurrently live executions share one writable Workspace Merged View; ending one does not revoke the other, and the last release unmounts without deleting the durable upper

evidence.value: exact SHA 0676864406c0aa52b9d5ccf535088a1b7f11c7e9 on Linux kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure: two concurrently verified Sandbox executions over managed Workspace /tmp/.tmpuPSkal/agent-workspaces/ws_two_consumers shared one physical fuse-overlayfs mount (consumers=2, same mountpoint/generation); execution A read B's write, A was released while B stayed live and read/wrote the same durable view; the last release unmounted the physical Overlay (mountinfo count 0) and retained upper/work
